fable.name: Fable
fable.thesis: Low headline VIX (14.9) masks a cracking tape — high-beta software down 5-7% while defensives and energy catch bids — into a dense catalyst window (NVDA earnings, inflation print, Sep 15-16 FOMC); stay small, hold energy, add a defensive sleeve and cheap defined-risk convexity, keep ~85% cash.
fable.justification: Doctrine first: we are early in the calibration log, so sizes stay small and flat-is-a-position dominates. XLE holds — the mechanism (generalist underweight in energy re-rating, confirmed by XOM/CVX +2%+ on a down tape) is intact and unbreached. Two small adds only: a defensive rotation long (structural — mandate-constrained funds rotate to low-beta ahead of known event risk, and utilities carry an AI-power-demand bid) and a tiny long QQQ put (behavioral — vol sellers pricing 14.9 VIX into NVDA earnings + CPI are giving away tail convexity; the alpha comes from systematic vol suppression flows that ignore the calendar). Nothing else clears the three-sentence test; the rest is cash earning the front-end yield.

positions.thesis: HOLD — generalist funds remain structurally underweight energy; relative strength confirmed (XOM +2.2%, CVX +2.3% on a red tape); mechanism unbroken.
positions.invalidation: Close below 60.90 (-6% from entry), or energy underperforms SPY by >4% over 10 sessions indicating the re-rating flow has reversed, by 2026-10-15.

sol.justification: The book has no existing positions to hold or sell. grok.name: Grok
grok.thesis: Complacent vol (VIX 14.9) into a steep 4.75% 10Y and FOMC in ~13 days; tape is rotation not a priced mispricing — cash is the position.
grok.justification: Book is flat, n=0 on this ledger, realized P&L $0: cold-start sizing and the three-sentence test both bind. Snapshot shows tech/cyber/crypto beta selling and energy/defensives bid, which is a regime description not an edge; headlines are stale/conflicting vs the 2026-09-02 print and are treated as untrusted data. No instrument clears invalidation-before-entry, named payer of alpha, and ≤50bps stop-risk without inventing a trade to look productive. Survive first; 10x in 12 months is not a mandate that overrides the risk constitution.

Portfolio gross exposure remains conservative at 78% with ~22% cash, staying well within correlation cluster and single-asset limits.
